title: RRDE5
summary: RRDE5 or Real Rider Deutschland 5-Spoke is a line of Hot Wheels Wheel Types introduced in 2027. The wheel features a 5-spoke design mimicking Porsche wheels of the period and was unveiled during the 2026 RLC sELECTIONs. Category:Wheel Types

title: HW Police Series (2020)
summary:
Centre|400px
In 2020, Hot Wheels released a series of 5 vehicles with decos inspired by police forces around the world. There was also a secondary theme to the series. The first sets came without the Hot Wheels logo and the card art reflected the "Missing Logo" with the castings in emergency response mode.
